title: CODATA 2022: the Bohr magneton is 9.274 010 0657 × 10⁻²⁴ J/T
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'Bohr magneton 9.274 010 0657 e-24' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 0029 e-24', unit J T⁻¹. This is the listing's value. A rounded '9.27 × 10⁻²⁴' drops digits the table actually prints.

sources.title: Fundamental Physical Constants, complete listing, 2022 CODATA adjustment
sources.author: NIST, CODATA 2022 recommended values
sources.note: Complete listing of the 2022 CODATA adjustment, opened 2026-11-18. Digits are from lines printed in full.
